question: A paper about AI regulation that was originally submitted to arXiv.org in June 2022 shows a figure with three axes, where each axis has a label word at both ends. Which of these words is used to describe a type of society in a Physics and Society article submitted to arXiv.org on August 11, 2016?

mistake_reason: At step 11, WebSurfer accessed the arXiv abstract for the 2016 Physics and Society paper (arXiv:1608.03637), which prominently contains the term "egalitarian" (e.g., in the title and abstract). However, WebSurfer provided only a vague, high-level summary focusing on hierarchy and withheld the explicit occurrence of "egalitarian". In subsequent steps (13 and 15), when asked to search for matches, WebSurfer again filtered out the critical data point by reporting absences for other terms while omitting that "egalitarian" appears multiple times. This information withholding (FM-2.4) misled the team to conclude that no axis terms matched, causing them to incorrectly choose "utilitarian" instead of the correct "egalitarian".
